protocol.order: AB/BA alternates by case and reverses in repetition two

manual_review.type: Evidence-grounding review, not an independent outcome score

protocol.privacy: Private prompts, source documents, tool arguments/results and generated research are excluded.
protocol.completion_metric: Usable artifact plus mandatory Junior note; does not certify all-role workflow compliance.
protocol.cost_policy: Use only matched pairs with complete usage on both sides. Other observed tokens are lower bounds.

limitations: Frozen tools are incomplete: unavailable-tool errors measure replay robustness, not live reliability.
Frozen get_market_data is case-scoped and ignores requested ticker; peer requests can receive a clearly labeled but mismatched case report. See manual fixture audit.
Two repetitions of a case are clustered, not independent held-out samples.
Shared model traffic/cache is uncontrolled; latency includes queueing.
Provider input/output usage is not a measurement of uncached GPU computation or monetary billing cost.
First-pass parser/contract checks do not simulate production repairs, reconciliation or order execution.
complete_with_required_step means usable artifact plus mandatory Junior note, not full all-role workflow compliance.
First-output timing includes content, reasoning or tool deltas and is observed only for completed turns; it is not server-only TTFT.

matched_both_usable_with_junior_note.interpretation: Conditional diagnostic, excluding pairs with transport/output/Junior-note failures; not the whole-workload cost effect.

limitations: Fixed diagnostic output measures memory input overhead, not role quality or production cycle speed.
